summary: Full Playwright regression + new-feature testing of LOW editor iteration 2 (multi-frames, undo/redo, JSON export/import, library drag, prototype linking). All 13 feature buckets from the review request PASS. Fresh-seed localStorage was used to obtain the multi-frame seed (Login + Home for p_finance).
critical_code_review_comments: EditorShell.dropItem: template preset key is derived from t.name.toLowerCase() (LeftSidebar), so templatePresets must have all keys matching dummyTemplates names exactly. Currently works because dummyTemplates names ('Login','Register','Onboarding','Home','Profile','Checkout') match preset keys. Adding a new template name that isn't a preset key silently falls back to templatePresets.login — consider a safer mapping or warning.

PreviewModal.resolveTarget falls back to name-based matching. Default seed's n_btn prototype.target='Home' (name string) rather than a frame id — this is intentional migration compat, but for consistency, seeding should use the actual frame id. Otherwise renaming 'Home' breaks the link silently.
EditorShell keydown Ctrl+Z ignores when typing in text/select/textarea (good), but 'contenteditable' and shadcn dialogs are not guarded — low risk here since editor has no contenteditable regions.

commitCoalesced captures snapshot only when pendingSnap.current is null; if a user rapidly performs 2 distinct edits within the 500ms window they collapse into one undo step — acceptable, but Ctrl+Z with rapid consecutive prop edits may feel coarser than expected.
storage.newId uses Math.random()+_idc; across page loads _idc resets to 0 while Math.random() keeps ids unique — no collision risk seen.
No _id / MongoDB usage — pure frontend, no server calls; ok.
React StrictMode double-invoke: EditorShell useState initial getProject(id) runs twice in dev; harmless because localStorage read is idempotent.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage at test start to obtain fresh multi-frame seed. Iteration_1's leftover localStorage was single-frame (before this iteration) which would have hidden the Home screen; clearing was necessary.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 buckets tested and pass: (1) multi-frame render + bottom status '3 screens · N layers', (2) Pages tab lists frame-item-<id> and click activates (blue border switches), (3) add-screen-btn increments frame count and activates new frame, (4) frame-delete removes + last-screen guard fires 'A project needs at least one screen' toast, (5) undo/redo disabled on fresh load, (6) property edit → undo reverts (x 24→100→24), redo re-applies (→100); Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z work when focus is on canvas, (7) Export triggers 'finance-app.low.json' download, (8) import-dropzone / import-json-btn / hidden file input present and non-crashing, (9) Component drag (c_button) via dispatched HTML5 DnD events (dragstart/dragover/drop with DataTransfer) added a node to the active frame (layers 7→8) with success toast + selection, (10) Template drag added a new screen (frames 2→3), (11) Prototype linking: set trigger=tap/action=navigate/target=Home, Preview modal opens, clicking Sign In navigates to 'Preview — Home', Back returns to Login, Restart+Close work; note that select_option with the frame id was overridden by the pre-seeded target='Home' name string but resolveTarget's name-fallback still routes correctly, (12) reload persistence confirmed (3 frames survived), (13) Regression: tool-rectangle adds a Rectangle layer, zoom-in/out buttons present, autosave-status shows 'Saving…' transitioning to 'Saved'. HTML5 DnD in Playwright must be simulated by dispatching DragEvent with a shared DataTransfer object on both source and target (drag_to alone does NOT populate dataTransfer).
